title: Witcher 3 Worth It in 2026? 96¢ an Hour
caption:
The Witcher 3 is $49.99 on Steam and takes about 52 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story): 96¢ an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 175 hours) and it drops to 29¢ an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with 300 hours in The Witcher 3. Its main story costs 96 cents an hour.
